documents.title: Bambu PLA Basic Gradient Technical Data Sheet (Bambu Filament TDS V2.0, headed "PLA Basic")
Bambu PLA Basic MSDS EGZ2302280031C00102RM1 (prepared by EMTEK (Guangzhou) for Shenzhen Tuozhu Technology)
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Basic Gradient
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: The TDS file is the store page's "Filament TDS" link (Bambu_PLA_Basic_Gradient_Technical_Data_Sheet.pdf), but its heading reads "PLA Basic" (TDS V2.0). Only the impact values carry *, tied to the footnote "As new color options in the PLA Basic series, the gradient filament retains similar performance to PLA Basic while providing even stronger toughness and Z-layer strength." The other rows are stored as this product's official TDS values, each noted.

Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 32 ± 5 MPa, elongation 8.3 ± 0.3 %, bending modulus 1990 ± 50 MPa, bending strength 68 ± 5 MPa, impact 23.8 ± 0.9 kJ/m² *) are not stored. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT come from the TDS "Physical Properties" table (ISO 1183, DSC, ISO 306, ISO 75; the TDS does not say whether the Vicat and HDT specimens were printed) and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows (the "Specimen Test" section: tensile, bending and impact).

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2580 ± 150 MPa, Z 1980 ± 100 MPa), melt index (45.8 ± 6.6 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), heat deflection temperature 57 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.43 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C), max overhang angle (55°), max bridging length (30 mm), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows. The support material ("Support for PLA", p.2) is recorded as a relation.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

The TDS "Bed Surface Preparation Glue" is a recommended setting, not a stated requirement, so no "requires" relation is written; the material-table wiki's "Glue Required" applies to the Engineering Plate only.

The SDS is a third-party lab document (prepared by EMTEK (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd. for Shenzhen Tuozhu Technology, data audit by EMTEK) for "Bambu PLA Basic"; a third-party lab value is never stored as a manufacturer spec, so its section 9 values (melting point 160℃, density 1.24 g/cm3, both agreeing with the TDS), its composition (polylactic acid 99 %, additive 0-1 %), CLP "not classified as hazardous" and "Not hazardous goods" for IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID and ICAO/IATA transport are not stored.

Source disagreements left to review: drying temperature (TDS and material-table wiki 55 °C, drying wiki 50 °C for "PLA Basic / PLA Matte"); bed temperature on the High Temperature and Textured PEI plates (TDS 35 - 45 °C for all three bed types vs material-table wiki 45 - 65 ℃ for "PLA"); nozzle temperature (TDS 190 - 230 °C vs material-table wiki 190 - 240 °C ±10 °C for "PLA*"). The product TDS values are kept.

The wiki pages name PLA Basic, never the gradient; they are applied through the store FAQ "PLA Basic Gradient is a new color option of PLA Basic series, please use the default PLA Basic setting for printing." and used only as corroboration and for relations.

Marketing prose proves no number: "Soft Bicolor Gradient", "Delicate Finish", "Good Layer Adhesion", "Up to 300mm/s (with 0.4mm nozzle)", "8 ~ 10 Meters Gradient Length" (the colour-transition length, not material.length) and the example consumptions ("14.8 m/45.09 g", "54.3 m/164.56 g") are not stored as values.

Hex: every store colour has exactly one cell in the hex table, matched by the colour name without the code in parentheses. Each cell publishes TWO hex codes (the gradient's top and bottom colours). published_hex holds a single #RRGGBB, so no single hex is chosen: both are kept as "hexes" in published order, with "gradient": true, and no "hex" field is written. How a two-stop gradient is shown is left to the integrator.

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0573/5320/7868/files/Bambu_PLA_Basic_RoHS.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 4); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
The store page states RFID ("All printing parameters are embedded in RFID, which can be read through our AMS"); no registry key holds it.

Adjudication against the second extraction (every differing value re-read in the cached TDS, SDS, hex table, wiki pages and store page): kept the TDS 1.8 MPa heat deflection row (54 °C; the 0.45 MPa row, 57 °C, is in test_condition), as for every PLA Basic filament file. Not taken: thermal.chamber_temp 25 - 45 °C (a printer capability key, see above; no filament file stores it); identity.series "PLA Basic" (the reviewed identity map gives identity.series "PLA", and a curated row would outrank it); compat.statement and extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters built from generic wiki rows (this TDS has no Nozzle Size row; the relations carry them); material.spool_type "ABS (Temperature resistance 70 °C); Diameter: 200 mm; Height: 67 mm" (spool material and size, not a spool type; see the TDS facts note); separate AMS, AMS lite, open-frame, enclosed-printer and per-size standard nozzle relations (covered by the "All AMS Series", "All printers" and "All standard nozzles" relations). Taken from it: the Bambu Engineering Plate, the three high-flow nozzle and the Support for PLA relations, and the source's own label "All AMS Series" (the store bullet "All AMS Series Compatible"). The second extraction's note that the SDS gives no density or melting point is wrong: the SDS section 9 (p.9) states melting point 160℃ and density 1.24 g/cm3 (not stored: third-party lab).
